messages:
jordan (Acme AI): Hey team — our org 54321 saw monthly credits refill happen ~2h later than expected this morning. Our billing cycle is 1st of month at 00:00 CET but we observed refill at 02:12 CET (UTC 00:12). This caused batch jobs to fail. Sample request id: req_0a12b3c4. Anyone seen timezone-related reset drift?

maya (Support): Sorry about that, @jordan. Can you confirm the org timezone set in the console and the observed timestamps (UTC and local)? Also share the account id and any billing logs you have.

jordan (Acme AI): Org timezone in console shows "Europe/Paris" and billing UI says next refill 2025-07-01 00:00 CEST. Observed server logs: "REFILL_TRIGGER org=54321 ts=2025-07-01T00:12:00Z". So refill happened at 00:12Z, which is 02:12 CEST. We expect 00:00 CEST.

ops-bot: Automated job "monthly_refill" ran for org=54321 at 2025-07-01T00:12:00Z (duration=3s) :gear:

lina (Billing Eng): Looking. Can you hold while I query the refill scheduler?

lina (Billing Eng): Quick check returned that refill jobs are scheduled by UTC midnight slot, then adjusted per-account offset using account.timezone_offset_minutes. For org 54321 that field is NULL. That causes fallback to server default (UTC) instead of Europe/Paris.

lina (Billing Eng): Query I ran:

```
SELECT org_id, timezone, timezone_offset_minutes, last_refill_utc
FROM billing.orgs
WHERE org_id = 54321;
```

Result: org_id=54321, timezone='Europe/Paris', timezone_offset_minutes=NULL, last_refill_utc='2025-07-01T00:12:00Z'

maya (Support): @lina so the console shows Europe/Paris but the DB offset is null. How did that happen?

lina (Billing Eng): Looks like a migration gap for accounts created before we added timezone_offset_minutes. We attempted a backfill but this org missed it due to an earlier failed job. We'll backfill and re-run refill.

sam (SRE): Rolling a hotfix: backfill script + idempotent reschedule of missed refills. Plan: run backfill, then trigger refill-run for affected orgs. ETA 30m. :rocket: 

maya (Support): @jordan we can apply a one-off manual top-up today so your jobs won't fail. Do you want that while we fix the backfill and re-run?

jordan (Acme AI): Please do the manual top-up. We had a few failed batches. Also would love a short postmortem once fixed.

maya (Support): Done — I've applied a 50k token manual credit to org 54321 and created a support ticket #SUP-8942. Also escalated to billing eng.

lina (Billing Eng): Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1427 will add an extra safety backfill and mark backfilled_at. I'll run it after CI.

sam (SRE): Backfill run started at 2025-07-01T00:40:00Z. Will report results.

ops-bot: Backfill job completed. Updated 1 orgs. org=54321 timezone_offset_minutes set to 120.

lina (Billing Eng): Re-triggered refund for org 54321 at 2025-07-01T00:41:10Z — refill timestamp set to 2025-07-01T00:00:00+02:00 in audit log.

maya (Support): Jordan — you should be all set. Refill now reflects midnight CEST and we applied manual credits. Sorry for the disruption.

jordan (Acme AI): Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround. Can you include the resolution steps in the ticket so our ops team can reference?

maya (Support): Will do — summarizing in #SUP-8942 and adding timeline + workaround. Follow-up: PR merged and scheduled to prod rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

lina (Billing Eng): Root cause summary: missing timezone_offset_minutes due to a failed migration backfill; scheduler fell back to UTC causing ~offset minutes drift (DST-aware). Fix: backfill + safe reschedule + CI guard for backfill failures.

sam (SRE): Postmortem draft will include detection alert (refill >5m tardy), Runbooks updated.

jordan (Acme AI): Great. :thumbsup:

maya (Support): Closing thread once ticket updated. Reopen if anything else crops up. :wave:
